description: Hand-curated queries for offline Precision@K of the recommender. Each query has a natural-language `prompt` (the user input) and an explicit `relevance` rule that ANY listing must satisfy to count as a true positive. Relevance is evaluated mechanically against the processed feature frame.

relevance_rule_format.has_complex_id: 0 or 1 — listing must be in a residential complex (1) or not in one (0)
relevance_rule_format.target_price_kzt_max: integer KZT — listing price must be <= this value
relevance_rule_format.target_price_kzt_min: integer KZT — listing price must be >= this value
relevance_rule_format.district: string — listing district must exactly match (case-insensitive)
relevance_rule_format.is_first_floor: 0 or 1 — listing must (1) be / (0) NOT be on first floor
relevance_rule_format.is_last_floor: 0 or 1 — same idea for last floor
relevance_rule_format.dist_to_center_km_max: float km — distance to center must be <= this
relevance_rule_format.*_nearest_dist_m_max: any POI feature with `_nearest_dist_m_max` suffix is an at-most-N-meters rule
